points.description: States that the collision domain diameter decreases by a factor of 10 (i.e. becomes one tenth of its original value) when the speed increases tenfold. Equivalent wording, such as 'reduced to a tenth' or 'divided by 10', earns the mark. A numerical example such as 300m to 30m is not required.

rubric.notes: The full mark is awarded for a student who says the diameter falls by a factor of 10, or to one tenth of its original size, with equivalent wording accepted. Any answer saying the diameter increases, stays the same, or falls by a different factor gets no mark. The example figures are secondary detail and are not needed for the mark.
